name: LJ Web Management API
description: Free, read-only JSON API for LJ Web Management's catalog of done-for-you AI automations, platform solutions, FAQ, and glossary. Responses are static JSON regenerated on every site build.
authentication: None. No API key is needed.

endpoints.description: Entry point for the API. Returns the name, version, documentation links, and every endpoint.
Returns LJ Web Management's description, contact email, phone, postal address, booking page, and pricing model.
Returns the 11 business-function categories that organize the automation catalog, with counts.
Returns one business-function category and a summary of every automation in it, across all industries.
Returns the 57 industries the automation catalog covers, with counts.
Returns one industry and every automation for it in full: role, steps, the manual process it replaces, and the tools it connects.
Returns every platform solution (CRM, ERP, websites, billing, AI agents, and more) grouped by category, with features, integrations, and FAQs.
Returns the tools and platforms the automations connect (for example Zapier, HubSpot, QuickBooks), with counts.
Returns every frequently asked question about pricing, process, tools, and industries, in plain text.
Returns plain-English definitions of automation and AI terms.
